model: VI-SPDAT (Single Adults, American Version 2.0) — published additive scoring
note: Control arm. Race is not an input to any VI-SPDAT scoring rule, and the only gender-dependent item in v2.0 is the pregnancy question, which no base profile sets. Any demographic difference here would be an error in the data, not a property of the tool.
underdisclosure_model: Withholds up to 3 of the most commonly concealed indicators a profile reports, in this order: b4_exploitation, d2_substance, d6_trauma, d3_mental, b3_legal, b2_harm, d5_medications, c4_relationships. Tri-morbidity is re-derived afterwards, so concealing substance use or mental health also removes it. The same mask is applied to all ten clones of a profile.
